description: Sports available, with whether each has upcoming matches. Free. Horse racing has its own tools (get_races, get_race, get_race_briefing, find_horses, get_runner_form, get_racing_stats), MMA (get_mma_events, get_mma_event, get_mma_fighter), golf (get_golf_tournaments, get_golf_leaderboard, get_golf_player; get_standings with sport golf), snooker and darts (get_snooker_darts_tournaments, get_snooker_darts_tournament, get_snooker_darts_player; get_standings with sport snooker or darts), boxing (get_boxing_events, get_boxing_event, get_boxing_fighter; get_standings with sport boxing for the current world champions).
name: list_sports
